description: This file defines the Schedule management class for broadcast scheduling, including nested classes for notification handling and section parsing, with methods for scanning, loading, and managing tuner states.

classes.name: Schedules
classes.description: Manages broadcast schedules, handles tuner notifications, and parses EIT sections.

classes.name: Schedules::Sink
classes.description: Handles tuner activation, deactivation, and state change notifications.

classes.name: Schedules::Parser
classes.description: Parses DVB EIT sections and loads schedule data.

methods.name: Schedules::Scan
methods.description: Starts or stops scanning for schedule updates.

methods.name: Schedules::StateChange
methods.description: Handles tuner state changes, adding or removing scanners accordingly.

methods.name: Schedules::Load
methods.description: Loads DVB EIT data into the schedule system.
